nodes.label: StreetQuest Brand Mark (Yellow Map Pin with Pink Star)
nodes.rationale: A yellow/amber gradient location pin with a thick dark-brown outline and a hot-pink star in its head, floating above a soft drop shadow on a pink-to-violet diagonal gradient background. The pin communicates GPS/real-world location; the star signals quests, rewards and collectibles; the saturated cartoon style signals a playful game.
